verdict.rationale: First-party docs state Keycloak can authenticate users against existing OpenID Connect or SAML 2.0 identity providers, configured through the admin console, with account linking across providers. A long-term production user independently reports integrating many external IdPs for SSO across multiple software stacks. Missing for 10: evidence naming Okta, Entra or Google Workspace specifically, and in-depth brokering configuration docs (metadata import, claim/attribute mappers).
